title: Al-Karim: The Divine Name a Man in the Fire Is Reminded He Claimed
excerpt: The word karim appears thirty times in the Quran, and most describe something other than God. In Surah Ad-Dukhan two of the divine names are spoken to a man in Hell — because he had said them about himself.
seo_title: Al-Karim: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Karim, the Generous, names God in Al-Infitar and An-Naml — and in Ad-Dukhan the words are quoted back to a man who had claimed them for himself.
